expected: bool leap_year(int year) { return year % 4 == 0 && (year % 100 != 0 || year % 400 == 0); }
prompt: Implement bool leap_year(int year), using the Gregorian rules.

expected: int triangular(int n) { return n > 0 ? n * (n + 1) / 2 : 0; }
prompt: Write a C++ function int triangular(int n) that returns the sum from 1 through n. Return zero if n is negative.

prompt: Implement std::string basename_of(const std::string& path). Return the part after the last slash or the whole string if there is no slash.

prompt: Implement unsigned binary_width(unsigned value), the number of bits needed to represent value without leading zeroes. Return zero for zero.
